summary: The root "mzn" refers to clouds. It can mean clouds of any kind, specifically white clouds, or clouds that are heavy with water.
lane: مُزْنٌ ذ Clouds (K, and Ham, p. 564) of any kind: (Ham, ibid:) or white clouds: (S, K, and Ham, p. 53:) or clouds containing water. (K.)
